name: cloud-deployment-monitor
title: 云部署监控
description: This skill enables comprehensive cloud infrastructure monitoring through automated deployment tracking, health checks, and configuration management. It leverages the cloud-deployment-monitor agent to analyze system performance, detect anomalies, and ensure optimal deployment operations across distributed environments. Use this skill when the user requests deployment monitoring, infrastructure health assessment, or continuous configuration management. The skill facilitates proactive identification of deployment issues and provides actionable insights for maintaining cloud service reliability.
